quranic.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
quranic.translation: Our Lord, give us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

quranic.arabic: رَبَّنَا لا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا
quranic.translation: Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred.

quranic.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا
quranic.translation: Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us.

quranic.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
quranic.translation: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and plant firmly our feet, and give us victory over the disbelieving people.

quranic.arabic: رَبَّنَا لاَ تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ
quranic.translation: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.

quranic.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
quranic.translation: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.

quranic.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
quranic.translation: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous.

prophetic.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ، وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
prophetic.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, from inability and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, from the burden of debt and from being overpowered by men.

prophetic.arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
prophetic.translation: O Changer of the hearts, make my heart firm upon Your religion.

prophetic.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
prophetic.translation: O Allah! I beseech You for guidance, piety, chastity and contentment.

prophetic.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعِلْمَ النَّافِعَ، وَالرِّزْقَ الطَّيِّبَ، وَالْعَمَلَ الْمُتَقَبَّلَ
prophetic.translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, goodly provision and acceptable deeds.

prophetic.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
prophetic.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your slave. I keep Your covenant and Your pledge as much as I am able. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I admit to Your blessings upon me, and I admit to my sin. So forgive me, for there is no one who can forgive sins except You.

daily.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
daily.translation: In the name of Allah we enter, and in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we place our trust.

daily.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
daily.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no power and no strength except with Allah.
O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.
O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty.

daily.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
daily.translation: All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me with no power nor might from myself.

protection.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
protection.translation: I seek refuge in the sum of Allah's Words from the evil of what He has created.

protection.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
protection.translation: In the Name of Allah, Who with His Name nothing can cause harm in the earth nor in the heavens, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

protection.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
protection.translation: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no deity except Him. On Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.

protection.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
protection.translation: O Allah, suffice me with what You have allowed instead of what You have forbidden, and make me independent of all others besides You.

protection.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
protection.translation: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
